$comment: What a scene's GLSL is handed and must define: the one home of the authoring contract. The docs guide, the consumer skill and the maintainer skill read or point at this file, and scripts/validate-shader-contract.mjs holds it to assemble.ts, common.glsl.ts and types.ts in both directions. The library never imports it.
entryDescription: Returns the pixel's colour in linear RGB over the ground. uv runs 0 to 1 on both axes from the bottom left, with no aspect correction; t is the scene's clock in seconds.

uniforms.name: u_size
uniforms.description: The drawing buffer's size in pixels. Divide its x by its y for the aspect ratio.

uniforms.name: u_time
uniforms.description: The scene's clock in seconds, the same value as t. It advances with speed and holds still under reduced motion.

uniforms.name: u_ground
uniforms.description: The ground the scene paints over, in linear RGB: the page ground, or a near-black of its own for a dark scene on a light page. Add light to it and return the sum.

uniforms.name: u_page
uniforms.description: The page ground itself, which the fades melt into.

uniforms.name: u_lightMode
uniforms.description: 1 when a dark scene is being laid onto a light page as a pale tint, otherwise 0.

uniforms.name: u_ratio
uniforms.description: Drawing-buffer pixels per CSS pixel. Multiply a size meant in CSS pixels by it.

uniforms.name: u_col
uniforms.description: The scene's colours in linear RGB, in the order its colours list names them. Unused slots are black.

uniforms.name: u_glyphs
uniforms.description: The scene's character ramp as one strip, a cell per character, white on black. Read its red channel.

uniforms.name: u_glyphCount
uniforms.description: How many characters the ramp holds.

helpers.description: An integer hash with no visible pattern, the base of the others.
A random number from 0 to 1 for an integer cell.
Four octaves of value noise, for cloud, smoke and water.

helpers.signature: float lobe(float d, float above, float below)
helpers.description: A soft falloff around zero with one width above it and another below, for a glow with a hard side and a soft one.
